tbesh_html:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.2; also called Raamiah at Neh.7.7;
Another name of re.e.la.yah (רְעֵלָיָה "Reelaiah" H7480)
§ Raamiah = "thunder of Jehovah"
1) one who returned from exile with Zerubbabel
1a) also 'Reelaiah'

strongs_1890.derivation: from H7481 (רָעַם) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has shaken;
